**q25.** Engine: Google CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`) wrapped by the in-repo filter engine at `internal/filter/` — `engine.go:13-57` (CEL env + parse), `schema.go` (declared fields), `parser.go` (CEL AST → dialect-agnostic condition IR in `ir.go`), `render.go` (IR → SQL). Mechanism: the API validates/passes the filter string (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_filter.go`) into `store.FindMemo.Filters`; each dialect driver calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` and `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.Dialect<X>, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go`), and the renderer emits dialect-specific SQL fragments plus bound args from the same condition tree (`internal/filter/render.go:231-237, 365-402`).

**q26.**
```
memo            — deleted directly (store/memo.go:158; sqlite/memo.go:237)
memo_relation   — deleted explicitly, both memo_id and related_memo_id sides (store/memo.go:142,145)
attachment      — deleted explicitly for attachments linked to the memo (store/memo.go:149-157), plus the underlying blob/local/S3 storage
memo (again)    — comment memos are deleted recursively by the handler, cascading the same three tables (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:568-576)
```
Note: `memo_share` has `FOREIGN KEY (memo_id) REFERENCES memo(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:102-110`), but SQLite opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:52`), so that cascade only fires on MySQL/PostgreSQL. `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but never deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:544-548`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the built SPA is embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo static middleware with an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed), `:41-60` (`FrontendService.Serve`, static + `spaFallbackMiddleware`), invoked from `server/server.go:72`. `pnpm release` builds into `server/router/frontend/dist` (AGENTS.md).

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — server/server.go:162-171: RunOnce(ctx) once at startup, then Run(ctx) with a time.Ticker every 12h (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41)
```
Nothing else is started; `startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:153-174`) wires only this one. Unused infrastructure:
- `internal/scheduler/` (cron-expression parser + job scheduler, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `job.go`) has no non-test importer anywhere in the repo.
- `server/runner/memopayload.Runner` (`NewRunner`/`RunOnce`, `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19,27`) is never instantiated; only the free function `RebuildMemoPayload` (`:74`) is used, inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.
- Webhook delivery uses its own 4 goroutine workers via `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`), not a server-managed runner.

```
interceptor — web/src/connect.ts:150 (authInterceptor), installed on the Connect transport at web/src/connect.ts:186-190; token helpers at :96-146; storage/cross-tab sync in web/src/auth-state.ts
token kinds — short-lived JWT access token (Authorization: Bearer, kept in localStorage, 15 min, proactively refreshed and retried once on Unauthenticated); long-lived refresh token in an HTTP-only cookie "memos_refresh" (sent via credentials: "include", web/src/connect.ts:58-63, refreshed through AuthService.RefreshToken at :72-81); Personal Access Tokens ("memos_pat_" prefix) for programmatic clients
backend package — server/auth/ (server/auth/token.go for generation/parsing, server/auth/authenticator.go for validation), enforced by NewAuthInterceptor (server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go) for Connect and the gateway auth middleware in server/router/api/v1/v1.go:69-97, with ACL rules in server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go
```

```
memo created:         APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called at memo_service.go:157)
memo updated:         APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called at memo_update_helpers.go:67)
```

The first three funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four then converge on `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`), whose worker goroutines perform the actual HTTP delivery in `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`).
